request.subject: CURIOSITY:GRAVEYARD

layers.text: Erase everything except the three grey headstones and the black iron fence: remove the green grass and the brown soil block under them completely, so the headstones and the fence stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the three headstones, the moss on them, the black iron fence, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
